name: nene
facts: The nēnē is Hawaii's state bird.

name: pueo
facts: The pueo is a Hawaiian short-eared owl (Asio flammeus sandwichensis).

name: silversword
facts: Found high on Haleakalā and Mauna Kea; many species are endangered.

name: ohia
facts: Foundation tree for many native forests; threatened by Rapid ʻŌhiʻa Death.

name: iiwi
facts: Scarlet honeycreeper; its curved bill matches native flowers.

name: honu
facts: Green sea turtle; protected in Hawaii waters.
